about: Shared local efforts: a finding on the map that people take forward together, linked to related work, organizations and the governments that might act. 'example' marks an illustrative example made by Threadlands to show the page: nobody submitted it and nobody has been contacted, so it is never labelled 'proposed'. A real effort is 'proposed' once someone submits it, and stays so until a person or organization has actually taken responsibility for its next step.

fields.responsible: who has taken responsibility for the next step, only once they have agreed: {name, kind: organization|person|office, since}
fields.next: the next step, who does it and by when
fields.jurisdictions: governments whose area covers the effort: possible, not contacted, until a step says otherwise
fields.record: dated public record; private correspondence and unconsented photos are never published

efforts.title: Street-tree shade for one hot area of eastern Iztapalapa
efforts.ask: Plant street trees to shade the sidewalks across the area outlined on the map, about 1 km² of eastern Iztapalapa where trees cover very little of the ground.
efforts.area: About 1 km² of eastern Iztapalapa, outlined on the map

next.text: A person or organization takes responsibility for the next step: walking the area with people who live there and choosing the first street to plant.

jurisdictions.name: Gobierno de la Ciudad de México

record.text: Created as a Threadlands example from the heat map, to show how an effort page works. Not a real effort; no one has been contacted.
